calls.statement:
SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS dist, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS last_load, sum(closing_value) AS val_all
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-09'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT cp.category AS as_is_cat, p.category AS as_was_cat, count(DISTINCT p.sku) AS skus, count(*) AS n, round(sum(fs.closing_value),2) AS val, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores, min(s.store_id) AS min_store, max(s.store_id) AS max_store
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-05' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
  AND (cp.category ILIKE '%paint%' OR p.category ILIKE '%paint%' OR cp.category ILIKE '%decor%')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement:
SELECT fs.week_ending_date, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores,
  sum(fs.closing_units) AS units, round(sum(fs.closing_value),2) AS val,
  round(sum(fs.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost),2) AS recomputed,
  sum(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_rows,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(fs.closing_value - fs.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch_rows
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-05' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
  AND p.category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY fs.week_ending_date ORDER BY 1

WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT fs.week_ending_date, SUM(fs.closing_value) AS closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week fs
  JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-05' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND cp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  GROUP BY fs.week_ending_date
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 'Paint & Decorating' AS category,
       ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS avg_weekly_closing_stock_value_at_cost_eur
FROM weekly
